notes: Independent solve: comparing y = x tanθ − gx²/(2u²cos²θ) with y = √3x − 0.2x² gives tanθ = √3, θ = 60°, and 0.2 = 10/(2u² × 0.25) = 20/u², so u² = 100 and u = 10 m s⁻¹. T = 2u sinθ/g = 2(10)(√3/2)/10 = √3 s = 1.732 s. The x² comparison is written on the magnitude of the coefficient, which is the standard reading and is unambiguous here. The mistake entry is correct: carrying u = 100 gives 10√3 s, which is not printed.
